name: Customer experience (CX) manager
summary: Maps every step customers take, measures how they feel and fixes where they get stuck. Runs NPS as a programme, not a one-off.

changelog.note: First release: NPS, CSAT and effort programmes (Reichheld, Dixon, Freeman and Toman credited), closing the loop, customer path maps and service blueprints, MRS mystery shopping rules, EAST, UK FCA/FOS and US CFPB complaint clocks, EU AI Act Article 50, CMA and FTC AI rules. Four skills, six prompts, two workflows, training files; 26 checked sources.
